info.title: TripPlanner Kernel API
info.description: Kernel MVP API over local curated sample data.

delete.description: Explicitly remove one durable preference group; never an implicit reset.

schema.title: Response Get Card Products Account Card Products Get
Response Get Wallet Account Wallet Get

get.description: Derive the kernel's ``UserWallet`` from stored rows. Never stored itself.
The caller's saved trips, newest first. Summaries only: no report bodies.

schema.title: Response List Trips Account Trips Get

post.description: Save the confirmed session's current plan as a new trip with revision 1.

schema.title: Response 422 Save Trip Account Trips Post

post.description: Append the attached session's *current* plan to the trip as the next revision.

schema.title: Response 422 Append Revision Account Trips  Trip Id  Revisions Post
Response 422 Get Trip Account Trips  Trip Id  Get

delete.description:
Hard-delete a trip, all its revisions and the planning session attached to it.

There is no tombstone. With a ``client_event_id`` a retried delete replays as 204
rather than reporting the 404 a genuine second delete gets.

schema.title: Response 422 Delete Trip Account Trips  Trip Id  Delete

get.description:
One stored revision, with its report returned exactly as it was stored.

The report is parsed as a plain JSON object and **not** validated through
``FinalReport``: a snapshot written under an older schema must read back as it
was computed, flagged by ``is_current_schema``, not silently reshaped.

schema.title: Response 422 Get Revision Account Trips  Trip Id  Revisions  Revision  Get

post.description: Plan a saved trip again with current prices; the result becomes the next revision.

schema.title: Response 422 Start Rerun Account Trips  Trip Id  Reruns Post

get.description: Progress of a re-run. After a restart the job is unknown (404); the trip is unchanged.

schema.title: Response 422 Rerun Status Account Trips  Trip Id  Reruns  Job Id  Get
Response Approve Action Planning Sessions  Session Id  Actions  Proposal Id  Approve Post
Response Reject Action Planning Sessions  Session Id  Actions  Proposal Id  Reject Post

post.description: Explicitly append the selected durable result; working approvals never autosave.

ApiErrorBody.title: ApiErrorBody
ApiErrorBody.description:
The ``detail`` of every typed saved-trip failure.

``code`` is a closed set, so a generated client can switch on it exhaustively.
``trip_id`` is present only on ``SESSION_ALREADY_SAVED``.

AuthErrorResponse.title: AuthErrorResponse
AuthErrorResponse.description: 401 (no or expired session) and 403 (CSRF check) carry a plain-string detail.

CardProductOut.title: CardProductOut
CardProductOut.description: Display-safe view of one attachable card product.

ConversationEvent.title: ConversationEvent
ConversationEvent.description: A persisted, user-visible event; never a raw transcript or model trace.

CostedTrip.title: CostedTrip
CostedTrip.description:
Estimator output consumed by the optimizer (spec 02 §3, minimal for M1).

In M1 the golden harness supplies ``lines`` directly (bypassing the estimator).

OfferOut.title: OfferOut
OfferOut.description: The offer terms the status was computed from (never paraphrased).

OfferProvenanceOut.title: OfferProvenanceOut
OfferProvenanceOut.description: Provenance of the offer terms, with the verification state made explicit.

PreferencePatch.title: PreferencePatch
PreferencePatch.description: Partial group replacement. Unspecified groups are preserved.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Trust metadata embedded on every fact row that can influence a recommendation.

RequestValidationErrorResponse.title: RequestValidationErrorResponse
RequestValidationErrorResponse.description: FastAPI's own 422 for a malformed request (before any handler runs).

RevisionOut.title: RevisionOut
RevisionOut.description: One stored revision. ``report`` is the stored JSON object, verbatim.

RunnerUp.title: RunnerUp
RunnerUp.description: Second-best option for a line, for the report's 'why not X?' section.

SavedTripErrorResponse.title: SavedTripErrorResponse
SavedTripErrorResponse.description: A typed saved-trip failure as it goes over the wire (FastAPI wraps it in ``detail``).

TravelPreferenceProfile.title: TravelPreferenceProfile
TravelPreferenceProfile.description:
One user's remembered travel preferences, grouped by domain.

Every leaf is an optional ``PreferenceValue`` — absence means "never
told us," not a default choice the system silently assumed.

TripLineTiming.title: TripLineTiming
TripLineTiming.description: One of this card's assigned lines, with how its payment timing was judged.

TripWindow.title: TripWindow
TripWindow.description: What the stored plan says about *when*. Travel dates, not payment dates.

UserWallet.title: UserWallet
UserWallet.description: The user's owned cards + optional points balances (from TripSpec, spec 01 §8).

ValuationOut.title: ValuationOut
ValuationOut.description: The existing ``PointValuation`` row a points bonus was valued with.

WalletEntryOut.title: WalletEntryOut
WalletEntryOut.description: Display-safe projection of one stored wallet row.

WalletEntryPatchIn.title: WalletEntryPatchIn
WalletEntryPatchIn.description: Patch body. Omitted fields are left alone; explicit ``null`` clears one.

WelcomeStatusErrorResponse.title: WelcomeStatusErrorResponse
WelcomeStatusErrorResponse.description: A typed welcome-status failure as it goes over the wire (wrapped in ``detail``).

WelcomeStatusIn.title: WelcomeStatusIn
WelcomeStatusIn.description: Which owned trip result to read, and the one optional figure only the user knows.

trip_alone_clears_minimum_if_conditions_.title: Trip Alone Clears Minimum If Conditions Hold

WelcomeWindowReport.title: WelcomeWindowReport
WelcomeWindowReport.description: Spec 18 §2's ``WelcomeWindowStatus`` plus the context spec 18 §3 requires.
